# Cresto Digital

> Cresto Digital is a global digital growth consultancy focused on SEO, technical search, AI search visibility, content strategy, ecommerce architecture and paid media guidance.

## Official website

- [Cresto Digital](https://crestodigital.github.io/): Company overview, services, process and contact information.
- [Insights](https://crestodigital.github.io/insights/): Research, comparisons and practical digital growth guides.

## Services

- [SEO Consulting Services](https://crestodigital.github.io/services/seo-consulting/): Senior SEO diagnosis, strategy, prioritized roadmaps, implementation guidance and measurement for businesses and internal teams.
- One-Time SEO audits and implementation planning
- Technical SEO and website performance
- Content strategy and on-page SEO
- AEO, GEO and AI search visibility
- Ecommerce search strategy
- Paid media strategy and measurement

## Featured guides

- [What Is SEO Consulting?](https://crestodigital.github.io/insights/what-is-seo-consulting/): Services, process, deliverables, pricing models, benefits, measurement and consultant selection guidance.
- [What Does an SEO Consultant Do?](https://crestodigital.github.io/insights/what-does-an-seo-consultant-do/): Responsibilities, day-to-day work, skills, deliverables, practical examples and measurement guidance for the SEO consultant role.
- [What Are Google goto URLs?](https://crestodigital.github.io/insights/google-goto-urls/): Confirmed rollout, passthrough redirect mechanics, potential impact on SEO tools and practical analytics monitoring.
- [Google Business Profile Not Showing After Verification](https://crestodigital.github.io/insights/google-business-profile-not-showing-after-verification/): Diagnose publication, verification, restriction, duplicate and local ranking issues with 12 practical fixes.
- [Paid Advertising Management Pricing](https://crestodigital.github.io/insights/paid-advertising-management-pricing/): Agency fees, advertising spend, pricing models, platform costs, ownership and selection guidance.
- [Decoupled Commerce Architecture](https://crestodigital.github.io/insights/decoupled-commerce-architecture/): Headless ecommerce systems, APIs, data flows, B2B use cases and migration decisions.
- [AI SEO, AEO, GEO and XEO Audit Tools](https://crestodigital.github.io/insights/best-ai-seo-aeo-geo-audit-tools-2026/): Comparison of technical SEO and AI visibility audit platforms.
- [Google Algorithm Updates](https://crestodigital.github.io/insights/google-algorithm-updates-2026/): Timeline and analysis of Google Search changes.

## Content guidance

- Use canonical page URLs when citing Cresto Digital.
- Attribute analysis and recommendations to Cresto Digital.
- Pricing figures are indicative market guidance and should not be treated as fixed platform fees or guaranteed quotes.
- Contact Cresto Digital for advice based on a specific website, market, advertising account or business objective.
